contract.delta: fixed strike/barrier/rate/volatility/T/m; undefined at initial S=H

learning.teacher: last-increment conditional payoff and first-transition LRM

timing.cache: fixed contract only; no result/input memoization

quality.standard_speed_adoption: requires all-seed quality, no material interpolation accuracy loss, positive full-cost advantage including labels/setup/fit/export/load/OOD/fallback

freeze_evidence.independent_review: full saved pilot recomputed; no objection to fixed phase=.5 refinement/tolerances
freeze_evidence.scope: fixed pilot points and midpoint phase; dense independent test verification remains required
freeze_evidence.node_phase_zero: diagnostic only; not an equally accurate oracle
freeze_evidence.training_budget_selection: predeclared before main fit; no test-based selection

source_digest_role: provenance only; numeric evidence is replayed with tolerances

tail.price_bound_method: discounted payoff cap times lower-tail union probability

mc.standard_error: IID path sample standard deviation, ddof=1, divided by sqrt(paths)
mc.comparison: 6 SE plus observed GL refinement difference and truncation bound; diagnostic, not confidence certification
mc.oss_survival: mean proposal survival_weight estimates original-contract survival; proposal survival count is not used

frequency.standard_error: IID path sample standard deviation, ddof=1, divided by sqrt(paths)
frequency.comparison: 6 SE plus observed GL refinement difference and truncation bound; diagnostic, not confidence certification
frequency.oss_survival: mean proposal survival_weight estimates original-contract survival; proposal survival count is not used

canonical_gate: fresh MC/diagnostic regeneration plus independent PDE test-grid comparison required

diagnostic.independence: separate diagnostic normal/uniform row streams; no diagnostic labels used for fitting
diagnostic.standard_error: IID sample variance ddof=1; analytic m1 entries have no MC SE

common_initialization.operation: zero CPU float64 scalar parameter + Adam + one zero-gradient step
common_initialization.scope: one shared initialization before six NN fits; no network fit
common_initialization.standalone_allocation: once per model, outside fit elapsed/cap

adoption.timing_and_full_cost: measured; see benchmark/costs and explicit unmeasured boundary
adoption.interpretation: paired NN quality and strong Hermite accuracy tradeoff retained; accuracy alone does not establish full-cost speed advantage

artifact.storage: small synthetic archive tracked with study

costs.p95_policy: Sum of observed p95 components is a component scenario, not measured total p95 or a confidence interval.
costs.unsupported_policy: Measured latency remains recorded, but an entire price+ordinary-Delta batch containing failed or undefined outputs cannot support successful speed or cost-recovery comparisons.
costs.experiment_accounting: Shared train labels are generated once across the experiment; per-model deployment comparisons charge them to each standalone fit, not as an all-experiment sum.

generation_commit_role: actual main-fit generation commit; numerical checks use tolerance, not source hash
